trials.answer: Use 0–1 BFS with a deque and distance relaxation: push a neighbor to the front when its edge has weight 0, and to the back when its weight is 1. Unlike unit-weight BFS, don’t mark a vertex permanently visited when first enqueued; a later route may improve its distance and parent. With an adjacency list, it runs in O(V + E) time and uses O(V) auxiliary space.
